wrap_main_with_hydra_main: wrap a python main function with hydra_main to integrate Hydra config management and Dora experiment tracking
create_HydraMain_instance: create a HydraMain instance wrapping a main function with a specified config name and config path for Hydra integration
get_xp_from_argv: get an XP experiment object from command-line argument overrides using the HydraMain get_xp method
compare_two_hydra_configs: compare two Hydra DictConfig objects and yield an iterator of all differences between them using _compare_config
convert_value_to_hydra_override: convert a python dict or list value into a Hydra-compatible override string using _hydra_value_as_override
